As Netflix (NFLX) Shares Rose, Shareholder Technology Crossover Management Vii LTD Has Cut Its Holding; Fort LP Has Trimmed Its Apple (AAPL) Stake by $8.12 Million; Share Value Declined 
April 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Michael Novogratz decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 52.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fort Lp sold 48,020 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael Novogratz held 43,105 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.30 million, down from 91,125 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fort Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $904.70 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.41% or $2.48 during the last trading session, reaching $178.3. About 15.25 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Technology Crossover Management Vii Ltd decreased its stake in Netflix Inc. (NFLX) by 9.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Technology Crossover Management Vii Ltd sold 500,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 58.31% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4.54M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $870.62 million, down from 5.04M at the end of the previous reported quarter. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 108.73% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.18% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Taro Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (NYSE:TARO) by 8,885 shares in the quarter, for a total of 172,411 shares, and has risen its stake in F5 Networks Inc (NASDAQ:FFIV). 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 16.45 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality.
